stories.title: Design Moments Table Schema
stories.goal: define a moments table that stores all feed moment types with polymorphic relationships
stories.benefit: unified feed display with consistent moment handling regardless of source or type
acceptanceCriteria: Moments table includes id (UUID, primary key), league_id (foreign key to leagues), moment_type (enum), created_at, updated_at timestamps
Moment_type enum includes: 'trade', 'match_result', 'power_rankings', 'matchup_prediction', 'commissioner_post', 'user_post', 'transaction'
Table includes last_activity_at timestamp for engagement-based sorting and feed bumping
Schema includes is_pinned boolean and pinned_by_user_id for admin content moderation
Table includes reference fields (power_ranking_id, matchup_id, post_id, etc.) for linking to specific content records

stories.title: Design Posts Table Schema
stories.goal: define a posts table for user-generated and commissioner text content
stories.benefit: league members can create and share text-based content with proper attribution and moderation
acceptanceCriteria: Posts table includes id (UUID, primary key), league_id (foreign key to leagues), author_user_id (foreign key to users), created_at, updated_at
Table stores post_type (enum: 'user_post', 'commissioner_post') for differentiating content sources
Schema includes content (text), is_deleted boolean, and deleted_at timestamp for soft deletion support
Table includes edited_at timestamp to track post modifications and display 'edited' indicator
Foreign key constraints ensure posts are deleted/hidden when author user or league is removed

stories.title: Design Comments Table Schema
stories.goal: define a comments table for threaded discussions on all moment types
stories.benefit: league members can engage in conversations on any feed moment with proper threading
acceptanceCriteria: Comments table includes id (UUID, primary key), moment_id (foreign key to moments), author_user_id (foreign key to users), created_at, updated_at
Table stores comment_text (text), parent_comment_id (self-referencing foreign key) for threading support
Schema includes is_deleted boolean and deleted_at for soft deletion while maintaining thread structure
Table includes edited_at timestamp for tracking modifications
Cascade delete ensures comments are removed when associated moment or author is deleted

stories.title: Design Reactions Table Schema
stories.goal: define a reactions table for emoji-based engagement on moments and comments
stories.benefit: league members can express reactions quickly without text comments, enhancing engagement
acceptanceCriteria: Reactions table includes id (UUID, primary key), user_id (foreign key to users), created_at timestamp
Table includes polymorphic references: reactable_type (enum: 'moment', 'comment'), reactable_id (UUID)
Schema stores emoji (string) for the specific emoji reaction selected by user
Composite unique index on (user_id, reactable_type, reactable_id, emoji) prevents duplicate reactions
Delete cascade ensures reactions are removed when user, moment, or comment is deleted

stories.title: Design Power Rankings Table Schema
stories.goal: define a power_rankings table for storing commissioner weekly team rankings
stories.benefit: rankings data persists for historical tracking and trajectory visualization across weeks
acceptanceCriteria: Power_rankings table includes id (UUID, primary key), league_id (foreign key to leagues), season, week_number, created_at, updated_at
Table stores status (enum: 'draft', 'published'), published_at timestamp, and published_by_user_id
Schema includes is_skipped boolean for weeks where commissioner chose not to publish rankings
Composite unique index on (league_id, season, week_number) ensures one ranking record per week
Foreign key to leagues ensures rankings are deleted when league is removed

stories.title: Design Power Ranking Entries Table Schema
stories.goal: define a power_ranking_entries table for individual team rankings within weekly power rankings
stories.benefit: each team's rank and commentary is stored separately for flexible querying and historical analysis
acceptanceCriteria: Power_ranking_entries table includes id (UUID, primary key), power_ranking_id (foreign key to power_rankings), team_id (foreign key to teams)
Table stores rank (integer), commentary (text), created_at, updated_at timestamps
Schema enforces rank uniqueness within a power ranking through composite unique index (power_ranking_id, rank)
Table links to stable_fantasy_user_id through teams table for dynasty league continuity
Cascade delete removes entries when parent power ranking is deleted

stories.title: Design Matchups Table Schema
stories.goal: define a matchups table for storing weekly team matchups and results
stories.benefit: matchup data supports commissioner predictions, pick'ems game, and historical record tracking
acceptanceCriteria: Matchups table includes id (UUID, primary key), league_id (foreign key to leagues), season, week_number, created_at, updated_at
Table stores team1_id and team2_id (foreign keys to teams) for the competing teams
Schema includes team1_score, team2_score (decimal), winner_team_id (foreign key to teams) for result tracking
Table includes matchup_type (enum: 'regular_season', 'playoff', 'toilet_bowl') for different bracket contexts
Table includes external_matchup_id for syncing with fantasy platform API data

stories.title: Design Matchup Predictions Table Schema
stories.goal: define a matchup_predictions table for commissioner weekly matchup predictions
stories.benefit: prediction data enables feed moments, grading after results, and commissioner track record analysis
acceptanceCriteria: Matchup_predictions table includes id (UUID, primary key), league_id (foreign key to leagues), season, week_number
Table stores matchup_id (foreign key to matchups), predicted_winner_team_id (foreign key to teams)
Schema includes prediction_commentary (text), status (enum: 'draft', 'published'), published_at timestamp
Table includes is_correct boolean and graded_at timestamp for post-stat-correction grading
Table includes is_featured boolean to mark 'Matchup of the Week' for prominent feed display

stories.title: Design Engagement Metrics Aggregation Schema
stories.goal: define a moment_engagement_metrics table for efficient feed sorting and analytics
stories.benefit: feed sorting queries execute efficiently without counting reactions and comments on every load
acceptanceCriteria: Moment_engagement_metrics table includes id (UUID, primary key), moment_id (foreign key to moments, unique)
Table stores comment_count (integer), reaction_count (integer), last_comment_at, last_reaction_at timestamps
Schema includes engagement_score (decimal) calculated from recency and volume for sorting algorithms
Table updates via database triggers when comments or reactions are added/removed
Index on engagement_score enables efficient feed queries for engagement-aware sorting

stories.title: Implement Content Foreign Key Relationships
stories.goal: establish all foreign key constraints and cascade behaviors for content data consistency
stories.benefit: database maintains referential integrity and prevents orphaned content records
acceptanceCriteria: Moments.league_id references leagues.id with ON DELETE CASCADE to remove moments when league deleted
Posts.author_user_id references users.id with ON DELETE CASCADE for user content cleanup
Comments.moment_id references moments.id with ON DELETE CASCADE to remove comments when moment deleted
Reactions.user_id references users.id with ON DELETE CASCADE for user reaction cleanup
Power_ranking_entries.team_id references teams.id with ON DELETE CASCADE for team data integrity
